newsitem.title: UK: Vodafone appoints new managing director.
newsitem.headline: Vodafone appoints new managing director.

text.p: Vodafone Group Plc said on Thursday that it has appointed David Channing Williams managing director of Vodafone Limited, the British mobile phone network operator.
Channing Williams, 48, will on January 1 take over from Chris Gent, who the company has previously announced is to succeed Sir Gerald Whent as chief executive of Vodafone Group.
He is an executive director of Vodafone and the chairman of the group of companies responsible for value added services, paging and data services.
"David Channing Williams brings extensive cellular experience to his new role, and has already made a major contribution to the growth of the group," said Whent.
